text.body:
śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ | śrīnārada uvāca | indrādyamaravargeṣu brahmanyatparamā'dbhutam | akṣayaṃ kavacaṃ nāma kathayasva mama prabho || 1||
yaddhṛtvā''karṇya vīrastu trailokya vijayī bhavet | brahmovāca | śṛṇu putra muniśreṣṭha kavacaṃ paramādbhutam || 2||
indrādidevavṛndaiśca nārāyaṇamukhācchratam | trailokyavijayasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ || 3||
ṛṣiśchando devatā ca sadā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | asya śrītrailokyavijayākṣayakavacasya prajāpatiṛrṣiḥ| anuṣṭupchandaḥ|, śrīnārāyaṇaḥ paramātmā devatā| dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe jape viniyogaḥ | pādau rakṣatu govindo jaṅghe pātu jagatprabhuḥ || 4||
ūrū dvau keśavaḥ pātu kaṭī dāmodarastataḥ | vadanaṃ śrīhariḥ pātu nāḍīdeśaṃ ca me'cyutaḥ || 5||
vāmapārśvaṃ tathā viṣṇurdakṣiṇaṃ ca sudarśanaḥ | bāhumūle vāsudevo hṛdayaṃ ca janārdanaḥ || 6||
kaṇṭhaṃ pātu varāhaśca kṛṣṇaśca mukhamaṇḍalam | karṇau me mādhavaḥ pātu hṛṣīkeśaśca nāsike || 7||
netre nārāyaṇaḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ | kapolaṃ keśavaḥ pātu cakrapāṇiḥ śirastathā || 8||
prabhāte mādhavaḥ pātu madhyāhne madhusūdanaḥ | dinānte daityanāśaśca rātrau rakṣatu candramāḥ || 9||
pūrvasyāṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo vāyavyāṃ ca janārdanaḥ | iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham || 10||
tava snehānmayā''khyātaṃ na vaktavyaṃ tu kasyacit | kavacaṃ dhārayedyastu sādhako dakṣiṇe bhuje || 11||
devā manuṣyā gandharvā yajñāstasya na saṃśayaḥ | yoṣidvāmabhuje caiva puruṣo dakṣiṇe bhuje || 12||
nibhṛyātkavacaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasiddhiyuto bhavet | kaṇṭhe yo dhārayedetat kavacaṃ matsvarūpiṇam || 13||
yuddhe jayamavāpnoti dyūte vāde ca sādhakaḥ | sarvathā jayamāpnoti niścitaṃ janmajanmani || 14||
aputro labhate putraṃ roganāśastathā bhavet | sarvatāpapramuktaśca viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 15||
|| iti brahmasaṃhitoktaṃ śrīgopālākṣayakavacaṃ sampūrṇam ||
